scripts.build:renderer: esbuild src/renderer/renderer.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --outfile=dist/renderer/renderer.js && esbuild src/renderer/status.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --outfile=dist/renderer/status.js && esbuild src/renderer/settings.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --outfile=dist/renderer/settings.js && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist/renderer',{recursive:true});require('fs').copyFileSync('src/renderer/index.html','dist/renderer/index.html');require('fs').copyFileSync('src/renderer/status.html','dist/renderer/status.html');require('fs').copyFileSync('src/renderer/settings.html','dist/renderer/settings.html')"
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run check && npm run build:renderer
scripts.build:fast: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.test: npm run build:main && node --test test/pet-stats.test.mjs test/placement.test.mjs test/skins.test.mjs test/temperament.test.mjs test/color.test.mjs test/notify.test.mjs test/social.test.mjs test/songs.test.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable
